name: Type
description: Type of asset

name: Name
description: Name used by technical staff to refer to the asset; might be left blank for many lower level assets

name: Unique ID
description: Unique number automatically assigned when creating an asset

name: Description
description: Additional information to help staff locate or identify an asset

name: Photo
description: Photos of the asset

name: Parent asset
description: Asset ID of the asset that is a parent to this asset

name: Location
description: Geographic location of the asset on the surface of the Earth; may be a point, line, or polygon

name: Location precision
description: Estimated uncertainty in the geographic coordinates, expressed as a distance

name: Survey elevation
description: Height above a reference surface, as measured by surveying or high-precision GNSS equipment; used for hydraulic modeling and engineering design. This value is distinct from the altitude captured automatically with GPS coordinates. For chambered assets such as manholes, the surveyed point is the center of the cover

name: Survey elevation datum
description: Vertical reference system used for Survey elevation and Invert level values

name: Elevation precision
description: Estimated uncertainty in the measurement of the elevation

name: Administrative region
description: Name that describes the administrative geography of the location; multiple levels may be separated by commas starting with the most general area, for example: Region, District, Municipality

name: Coverage area
description: Geographical area where the sanitation system or service provides coverage or is legally obligated to serve

name: Sector
description: Name for a sub-region of the coverage area that is defined by geography or the physical layout of the collection network

name: Route
description: Name or number of the service route, such as a scheduled emptying (desludging) route, which defines the assets assigned to a particular staff member or team

name: Address
description: Physical address or postal address where the asset is located; in the case of sewer or property connections, the address of the customer

name: Urban-rural classification
description: Degree of urbanization, as defined by national standards or the Degree of Urbanisation method (OECD 2021)

name: Community
description: Name of the community, town, or neighborhood where a sanitation system or facility is located

name: Accessible by road
description: Asset can be accessed by vehicles using a nearby road

name: Perimeter fence or wall installed
description: Fence or wall exists to provide physical security for the asset

name: Wheelchair accessible
description: Asset can be accessed and used by people using wheelchairs or with limited mobility

name: Distance to nearest water source
description: Distance from the containment or dispersal structure to the nearest well, borehole, spring, or other groundwater source used for drinking water

name: Land occupancy
description: Legal status of the land the asset occupies or crosses
applicability: All types except: Sanitation system, subsystem

name: Level 1
description: Highest or most general level of categorization to which the asset belongs under the asset hierarchy

name: Level 2
description: Second highest level of hierarchy

name: Level 3
description: Third highest level of hierarchy

name: Level 4
description: Fourth highest level of hierarchy

name: Level 5
description: Fifth highest level of hierarchy

name: Level 6
description: Sixth highest level of hierarchy

name: Level 7
description: Lowest level of hierarchy

name: Status
description: How the asset is currently being used or operated

name: Condition
description: The physical or structural integrity of the asset

name: Functional status
description: Most recent observation of whether a sanitation system or sanitation point is working as designed

name: Current replacement cost (USD)
description: Cost (in US Dollars) that would be incurred to replace the asset at the current time; this value requires regular updating based on depreciation and current market conditions; also known as CRC

name: Expected useful life
description: Number of years that the asset is estimated to function after installation if it is well maintained; also known as EUL

name: Probability of failure
description: Measure of the likelihood of a failure happening at any point in time, based on an analysis of the potential failure modes of the asset

name: Consequence of failure
description: Measure of the direct and indirect costs of asset failure, which may include financial, environmental, and societal costs

name: Asset risk
description: Business or organizational risk of asset failure, usually calculated from the probability and consequence of failure

name: Original cost (USD)
description: Total price paid (in US Dollars) to initially acquire an asset

name: Current rehabilitation cost (USD)
description: Cost (in US Dollars) that would be incurred to rehabilitate the asset at the current time

name: Manufacturer
description: Name of the business that produced or sold the asset
applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Power, Meter, Electrical, Valve, Sensor, Analyzer, Vehicle, Connection, Datalogger, Treatment, Containment, Manhole

name: Model
description: Manufacturer's designation for the particular model of the asset
applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Power, Meter, Electrical, Valve, Sensor, Analyzer, Vehicle, Connection, Datalogger, Treatment, Containment, Manhole

name: Serial number
description: Unique identifying number or code assigned to a particular asset by the manufacturer or vendor, usually stamped or printed on the asset
applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Power, Meter, Electrical, Valve, Sensor, Analyzer, Vehicle, Connection, Datalogger, Treatment, Containment, Manhole

name: Additional technical details
description: Any other technical information about the asset that is not captured by the attributes of this standard

name: Installation date
description: Calendar date when the asset was installed or purchased, which begins the period of useful life

name: Installed by
description: Name of the company or organization that originally installed or purchased the asset

name: Funded by
description: Name of the funding authority, lender, or donor who funded the purchase of the system or facility

name: Rehabilitation date
description: Date of most recent work done to restore the asset to its original level of service and extend its life

name: Last service date
description: Date of most recent service or maintenance performed; for containment assets, the date of most recent emptying

name: Last calibration date
description: Calendar date when the device was last calibrated against a known reference or standard solution

name: Rehabilitated by
description: Name of the company or organization that performed the most recent rehabilitation of the asset

name: Service interval
description: Recommended interval at which service or routine maintenance should be performed on the asset, such as the scheduled emptying frequency of a containment asset or the calibration of a measuring device
applicability: All types except: Sanitation system, Subsystem, Facility, Connection

name: Date of manufacture
description: Calendar date when the asset was manufactured
applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Power, Meter, Electrical, Valve, Sensor, Analyzer, Vehicle, Connection, Datalogger

name: Decommissioning date
description: Calendar date when the asset was permanently taken out of service

name: Owner
description: Name of the individual, organization, or authority that holds legal ownership of the asset, which may differ from the organization that operates or manages it

name: Operator
description: Name of the individual, organization, or authority that operates or maintains the asset, if different from the owner; assets without an operator recorded are assumed to be operated by their parent system's operator
applicability: Type: Sanitation system, Facility, Sanitation point, Vehicle

name: Upstream asset
description: Asset ID of the upstream asset from which this asset receives flow
applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Treatment, Meter, Valve, Flow control, Junction, Sampling point, Sanitation point, Containment, Manhole, Dispersal, Outfall, Pipe, Channel, Connection

name: Downstream asset
description: Asset ID of the downstream asset that receives flow from this asset
applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Treatment, Meter, Valve, Flow control, Junction, Sampling point, Sanitation point, Containment, Manhole, Dispersal, Outfall, Pipe, Channel, Connection

name: Nominal diameter
description: An approximate measurement of the internal diameter of a pipe, conduit, pump, or junction, which is used to classify according to standard sizes
applicability: Type: Meter, Valve, Junction, Pipe, Connection

name: Pipe length
description: Total length of the pipe itself, measured along its slope from the start to the end of the pipe and excluding manhole chambers, for use in hydraulic calculations and modeling

name: Material
description: Material of construction for pipes, junctions, chambers, and other conduits
applicability: Type: Meter, Valve, Junction, Pipe, Manhole, Containment, Channel

name: Minor loss coefficient
description: Dimensionless coefficient that can be used to account for the head loss associated with turbulence in bends, junctions, meters, and valves; usually applicable to pressurized (rising) mains

name: Roughness coefficient
description: Dimensionless coefficient used to account for friction losses in flowing conduits, such as Manning's n for gravity sewers and open channels or Hazen-Williams C for pressurized mains

name: Conveyed content
description: Primary type of flow or material conveyed or handled by the asset
applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Valve, Flow control, Meter, Junction, Sampling point, Manhole, Outfall, Pipe, Channel

name: Invert level
description: Elevation of the lowest point of the internal surface of a channel or chamber, recorded against the same datum as Survey elevation

name: Primary contact name
description: Individual or office responsible for management or administration of the sanitation system or sanitation point
applicability: Type: Sanitation system,Subsystem, Facility, Sanitation point

name: Primary contact position
description: Title or role in the organization of the primary contact
applicability: Type: Sanitation system,Subsystem, Facility, Sanitation point

name: Primary contact phone number
description: Phone number of the primary contact
applicability: Type: Sanitation system,Subsystem, Facility, Sanitation point

name: Secondary contact name
description: Additional individual who may be contacted if the primary contact is not available
applicability: Type: Sanitation system,Subsystem, Facility, Sanitation point

name: Secondary contact position
description: Title or role of the secondary contact
applicability: Type: Sanitation system,Subsystem, Facility, Sanitation point

name: Secondary contact phone number
description: Phone number of the secondary contact
applicability: Type: Sanitation system,Subsystem, Facility, Sanitation point

name: Date updated
description: Calendar date of the most recent update made to any attribute

name: Date inspected
description: Calendar date of the most recent inspection or audit of the asset, as defined by organizational asset management policies

name: Alternate ID
description: Optional additional identification code or number that is used by other data systems or organizations to track the asset

name: Import code
description: Identification code for an asset that was assigned by an external database or asset management registry, used to maintain backwards traceability for assets that have been imported

name: Permit or licence number
description: Identification number of the primary permit, licence, or registration issued for the asset by a regulator or government authority
applicability: Type: Sanitation system, Facility, Sanitation point, Vehicle, Outfall

name: Sanitation system type
description: Categorization of the system by how excreta and wastewater are contained and conveyed: through a sewer network, in on-site containment, or both

name: Sewer network type
description: Categorization of the collecting network by what it is designed to carry: wastewater only in separate sewers, wastewater and stormwater together in combined sewers, or both

name: Management type
description: Type of organization that manages the operations, maintenance, and finances of the sanitation system

name: Number of households in service area
description: Total number of households within the area that a service provider is legally mandated to offer services to

name: Number of households currently served
description: Number of households currently receiving service, whether through a functional sewer connection or through regular servicing of on-site containment (includes households with inactive, intermittent, or cut off service, if service could be re-established)

name: System or network diagram
description: Photograph of a recent map or diagram showing the location of sanitation infrastructure, such as the collection network and treatment assets

name: Total treatment capacity
description: Indicative amount of wastewater and faecal sludge that the system's treatment assets are able to receive and treat, within current resource and design constraints

name: Sewer technology
description: Predominant sewer technology used in the collecting network

name: Design capacity (population equivalent)
description: Design capacity of the system expressed in population equivalent (p.e.), a standardized load unit where 1 p.e. is an organic biodegradable load with a five-day biochemical oxygen demand (BOD₅) of 60 g of oxygen per day, independent of actual local per-capita loads (Directive (EU) 2024/3019, Art. 2(10))

name: Facility type
description: Type of physical location where a specific function is performed in the collection, transport, treatment, or disposal/reuse of wastewater and faecal sludge

name: Process area type
description: Optional label used to categorize process areas within a facility

name: Equipped to receive faecal sludge
description: The treatment facility is equipped to receive faecal sludge or septage delivered by vehicle, in addition to sewered flow, such as through a discharge structure or receiving station

name: Sanitation point type
description: Type of technology used by the sanitation point to collect user excreta across sewered and non-sewered systems

name: Number of cubicles or stances
description: Total number of individual cubicles, stances, or seats available at the sanitation point

name: Usage arrangement
description: Categorization of the sanitation point by who uses it and how access is arranged

name: Separate facilities for women and girls
description: Sanitation point provides separate, private cubicles or blocks designated for use by women and girls
applicability: Usage arrangement: Shared (limited number of households), Communal or public, Institutional

name: Pan style
description: Style of toilet pan or seat installed

name: Connection type
description: Categorization of the connection based on the type of user or customer premises served

name: Customer ID
description: Identification code used by the billing or commercial system for the customer or property served by this connection

name: Connection status
description: Current service status of the connection

name: Interceptor tank installed
description: An interceptor tank, such as a septic tank, is installed upstream of this connection to retain settleable solids before discharge to the network (settled or solids-free sewerage)

name: Backflow prevention installed
description: A non-return valve or other backflow-prevention device is installed on the connection to prevent sewer surcharge from flowing back into the property

name: Containment type
description: Type of technology used to collect, store, and partially treat excreta and wastewater at or near the point of generation

name: Number of compartments
description: Number of separate chambers within the containment structure

name: Storage volume
description: Effective storage or holding capacity of the containment structure

name: Containment depth
description: Vertical distance from the ground surface, slab, or access opening to the bottom of the containment structure; for pits, the excavated depth

name: Lined or sealed
description: Degree to which the containment structure prevents infiltration of its contents into the surrounding soil

name: Outlet arrangement
description: Categorization of where liquid effluent or overflow from the containment structure discharges

name: Emptying access
description: Extent to which the containment structure can be physically accessed for emptying (desludging)

name: Number of users sharing
description: Number of individual users that share use of this containment structure

name: Vehicle type
description: Categorization of the mobile asset used to empty, transport, or transfer faecal sludge, septage, or wastewater, or to maintain the collection network

name: Registration number
description: Official license plate or registration number issued to the vehicle by a government authority

name: Tank or load capacity
description: Maximum volume of faecal sludge, septage, or wastewater that the vehicle's tank or load bed can hold

name: Vacuum pump fitted
description: Whether the vehicle is equipped with a vacuum pump used to suction faecal sludge, septage, or wastewater from a containment system

name: Manhole type
description: Categorization of the manhole by its access function

name: Chamber depth
description: Vertical distance from the manhole cover to the invert or floor of the chamber

name: Cover shape
description: Shape of the manhole cover and frame

name: Cover diameter
description: Nominal diameter of a round manhole cover

name: Cover length
description: Length of a rectangular manhole cover, measured along its longer side

name: Cover width
description: Width of a rectangular manhole cover, measured along its shorter side

name: Cover load class
description: Load-bearing classification of the manhole cover per EN 124

name: Access aid type
description: Type of fixed steps, ladder, or rungs installed inside the chamber for entry

name: Junction type
description: Type of fitting used where two or more pipes or conduits connect

name: Valve type
description: Purpose or design of a valve used to close off or regulate the flow of wastewater, sludge, or air in a pipe or closed conduit

name: Date of last actuation
description: Most recent date that the valve was actuated to prevent degradation and verify functionality

name: Flow control element type
description: Physical form of the flow control element, independent of the function it serves (32102)

name: Flow control function
description: Primary hydraulic function the flow control element serves in the system, independent of its physical form (32101)

name: Structure type
description: Type of ancillary structure present at a sanitation asset site

name: Perimeter type
description: Type of perimeter design

name: Perimeter total length
description: Total length of the entire perimeter that is being defined as an asset

name: Perimeter height
description: Typical or minimum height of the perimeter

name: Perimeter setback distance
description: Typical or minimum distance from the perimeter from the structure or equipment it is designed to protect

name: Power type
description: Categorization of the power generating device based on design or principles of operation

name: Rated power output
description: Power output that can be sustained for long periods of time; for generators this is the continuous power rating

name: Maximum power output
description: Power output that can be provided for short periods of time in response to surges in demand; for generators, sometimes referred to as the standby or intermittent power rating

name: Nominal voltage
description: Voltage assigned to a system or circuit of a given voltage class for the purpose of convenient designation; the actual operating voltage may vary above or below this value

name: Rated voltage
description: Maximum voltage at which the power system can be operated within thermal and safety limits

name: Maximum current
description: Maximum safe current, or starting current, that can be supplied for a short period of time

name: Type of current
description: Mode of transmission for electrical current (AC/DC)

name: Frequency of current
description: Frequency at which the voltage rises to a peak, reverses, and rises to a peak again

name: Generator fuel
description: Type of fuel required by the generator

name: Generator apparent power
description: Product of the voltage and current provided in an AC power system, which does not account for the reactive power required by inductive loads in the circuit; sometimes referred to by its most common unit of measurement: kVA

name: Engine cooling system
description: Type of cooling system used by the generator engine

name: PV panel type
description: Photovoltaic panel type

name: Total number of PV panels
description: Total number of photovoltaic panels installed in the power system

name: Electrical type
description: Type of electrical asset

name: Electrical power device type
description: Classification of electrical power device based on purpose or mode of operation

name: Meter ID
description: Identification number or code used by the service provider to identify the meter

name: Meter type
description: Location or function of the flow being measured within the wastewater, effluent, or sludge stream

name: Meter design
description: Design or operating principle of the meter

name: Minimum measurable flow rate
description: Lowest flow rate that can be measured by the meter

name: Meter measurement type
description: Type of measurement displayed by the meter (total volume, flow rate, or both)

name: Sampling point type
description: Location in the wastewater or faecal sludge stream where a sample is collected for water quality or process testing, including regulatory compliance points

name: Regulatory compliance point
description: Sampling point designated for regulatory compliance monitoring under a discharge permit or national monitoring program

name: Autosampler installed
description: A fixed automatic sampler is installed at this point to collect composite or sequential samples

name: Sensor type
description: Physical or field parameter measured by the sensor

name: Gas measured
description: Gas or gases that the sensor measures

name: Gases measured
description: Gases that a multi-gas instrument measures, separated by commas — for example: hydrogen sulfide, methane, oxygen. Use the names given in Gas measured where they apply

name: Analyzer type
description: Water quality or process parameter measured by the analyzer

name: Parameters measured
description: Parameters that a multiparameter analyzer measures, separated by commas

name: Transmission method
description: Method by which recorded data are transmitted from the datalogger to the systems or staff that use them

name: Pump type
description: Description of the pump mechanism or operating principle used to empty, convey, or transfer wastewater or faecal sludge

name: Pump diameter
description: Maximum outer diameter of a submersible pump

name: Pump power rating
description: Power consumed by a pump operating under normal pressure and flow conditions, as defined by the manufacturer
applicability: Pump type is not Manual pump

name: Pump motor configuration
description: Whether the motor and pump should be tracked as a single asset or as separate assets; in cases where the motor is separate from the pump, this generally means that motors are interchangeable between pumps of a similar design
applicability: Pump type is not Manual pump

name: Pump motor voltage type
description: Type of electrical power required by the pump
applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

name: Pump motor voltage
description: Normal operating voltage of the pump, as recommended by the manufacturer
applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

name: Pump motor max current
description: Current drawn by the pump when operating at the maximum or full load power rating
applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

name: Pump motor max power
description: Maximum, or full load power rating of the pump, as recommended by the manufacturer
applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

name: Design flow
description: Flow rate of the pump required by the system design under normal operating conditions; should be within the acceptable flow range as defined by the pump curve

name: Design head
description: Head, or pressure, shown on the pump curve at the design flow rate

name: Maximum flow (Q-max)
description: Maximum possible flow rate shown on the pump curve

name: Head at maximum flow (H-min)
description: Total head, or pressure, that corresponds to the maximum flow rate on the pump curve; also referred to as the minimum head

name: Minimum flow (Q-min)
description: Minimum possible flow rate shown on the pump curve

name: Head at minimum flow (H-max)
description: Total head, or pressure, that corresponds to the minimum flow rate on the pump curve; also referred to as the maximum head

name: NPSH-R
description: Net positive suction head required (or minimum) by the suction side of the pump in order to prevent cavitation and evaporation (flashing)

name: Tank type
description: Function or purpose of the tank within the conveyance network or treatment facility

name: Tank material
description: Main material of construction used in the tank

name: Tank volume
description: Useful volume of the tank which can be supplied between the minimum and maximum operating levels

name: Tank shape
description: Basic shape or form factor of the tank

name: Tank diameter
description: Diameter of the base of a cylindrical tank

name: Tank height
description: Distance from the bottom to the top of the tank, measured from outside

name: Tank length
description: Length of the longest side of the base of a rectangular tank

name: Tank width
description: Length of the shortest side of the base of a rectangular tank

name: Height of tank bottom
description: Distance from the ground level to the bottom of the inside of the tank; negative values are used for depths below the ground

name: Minimum operating level
description: Minimum fluid level allowed in the tank, measured from the tank bottom; this may be the height of the outlet or the minimum level allowed by a level control

name: Maximum operating level
description: Maximum fluid level allowed in the tank, measured from the tank bottom; this may be the height of the overflow pipe or the maximum level allowed by a level control

name: Level indicator installed
description: Device is installed that provides a visual or electronic measurement of the tank fill level, used to trigger alarms or control pumps

name: Treatment type
description: Categorization of treatment process by treatment method or objective, spanning liquid-stream (wastewater) and sludge/faecal sludge treatment technologies

name: Treatment level
description: Stage of treatment achieved by this unit, based on the pollutant-removal mechanism used; choices follow the legal definitions in Directive (EU) 2024/3019, Art. 2(11)-(14)

name: Design capacity of the unit
description: Design flow capacity of this specific treatment unit or process

name: Design organic load capacity of the unit
description: Design organic load capacity of this treatment unit, measured as the mass of five-day biochemical oxygen demand (BOD₅) treated per day

name: Surface area
description: Plan surface area of the treatment unit at the water or bed surface, such as a pond, wetland, drying bed, or basin
applicability: Treatment type: Waste stabilization pond, Aerated lagoon or pond, Free-water surface constructed wetland, Horizontal subsurface flow constructed wetland, Vertical flow constructed wetland, Unplanted drying bed, Planted drying bed

name: Depth
description: Vertical distance from the water or bed surface to the bottom of the treatment unit; for ponds, the design liquid depth excluding freeboard
applicability: Treatment type: Waste stabilization pond, Aerated lagoon or pond, Free-water surface constructed wetland, Horizontal subsurface flow constructed wetland, Vertical flow constructed wetland, Unplanted drying bed, Planted drying bed

name: Liner
description: Type of liner installed to control seepage from the treatment unit into the surrounding soil
applicability: Treatment type: Waste stabilization pond, Aerated lagoon or pond, Free-water surface constructed wetland, Horizontal subsurface flow constructed wetland, Vertical flow constructed wetland, Unplanted drying bed, Planted drying bed

name: Primary chemical used
description: Primary chemical stored and used by this treatment unit or process
applicability: Treatment type: Chlorination, Disinfection, Chemical feed, Coagulation or flocculation, Nutrient removal (nitrogen or phosphorus), Lime stabilization

name: Dispersal type
description: Type of technology used to discharge treated or partially treated effluent to the soil for infiltration or evapotranspiration

name: Outfall type
description: Categorization of the outfall by the type of discharge it conveys to the receiving environment

name: Receiving water name
description: Name of the water body receiving the effluent or overflow, if one exists

name: Screen or control installed
description: A physical screen, grate, tide gate, or flow-control device is installed at the outfall to remove solids or regulate discharge

name: Receiving environment type
description: Type of water body or environment receiving the discharge

name: Other vertical asset type
description: Description or categorization of the other type of vertical asset

name: Pipe type
description: Category of sewer pipe by its position and function in the collection network

name: Nominal pressure
description: Numerical designation of design pressure that is a convenient round number for reference purposes
applicability: Pipe type: Rising main (force main), Inverted siphon

name: Pipe depth below ground
description: Depth of the pipe below the local ground surface

name: Upstream invert level
description: Elevation of the lowest point of the internal pipe surface at the upstream end, recorded against the same datum as Survey elevation

name: Downstream invert level
description: Elevation of the lowest point of the internal pipe surface at the downstream end, recorded against the same datum as Survey elevation

name: Cross-section shape
description: Shape of the pipe's internal cross-section

name: Gradient
description: Slope of the pipe between upstream and downstream inverts, expressed as a percentage

name: Channel cross-section shape
description: Shape of the open channel's cross-section

name: Lined
description: The channel bed and sides have a constructed lining, such as concrete, masonry, or a synthetic membrane, to control seepage and erosion, as opposed to an unlined earthen channel

name: Covered or open
description: Whether the channel is open to the atmosphere or has a fixed cover or slab over it

name: Channel depth
description: Vertical distance from the top of the channel side or lining to the invert (lowest point) of the channel, measured internally

name: Channel top width
description: Internal width of the channel measured at the top, between the inner faces of the channel sides

name: Gradient
description: Slope of the channel between its upstream and downstream inverts, expressed as a percentage
